The migration workstream remains on track. Database cutover completed for
the reporting cluster, and the remaining services are scheduled in two
batches. No customer-facing downtime was recorded during the March window,
and the rollback plan was not needed.

April specifics: the payments service is the last remaining batch and is
scheduled for the 22nd, pending sign-off from the compliance review that
started this week. Load testing on the new cluster showed p99 latency of
180ms against the 250ms budget.

Overall, teams continue to make progress on their respective priorities.
Further updates will be shared through the usual channels as things
develop.
